steps.content: In the darkness, the corridor stretches on without end. Using the faint glow of her laptop screen, Norma runs her hand along the wall, only to find it rough and cold. Concrete.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...Concrete. Modern construction. This is another space entirely?
She continues forward. Clack, clack, clack. Her footsteps echo through the empty corridor. But soon, Norma notices something amiss.

A dark figure has been tailing her, always at a fixed distance—never too far, never too close. This is no ordinary pursuit. The shadow maintains an eerily exact interval, as though constantly calibrating its position against hers.
